anchoring: labels anchored at a past peak or fixed threshold give a decline already under way a mechanical head start; labels anchored at the current level (forward returns) do not, so the no-forecast drawdown score is expected near 0.5 there while pi still counts positives issued after the decline began
bootstrap: 500 draws, calendar-year blocks (daily and monthly rows), 7-day blocks (1-minute rows)

btc_rows.guards: positive count and event-anchored in-progress share equal notebook 22 at every H
btc_rows.labels: notebook-22 catalogs (30-240 minutes before a breach)
btc_rows.minutes: notebook-22 evaluation minutes for the 24-hour RV score

caveat: label conventions are reconstructed approximately on public data over longer samples than the original studies; no study result, sample or model is replicated or evaluated
changes_from_v1: this paper rows recomputed with the common trailing-high rule at four windows (v1 used the event-anchored 1% onset)
share of excess removed from the table; not-yet and in-progress AUC and the lower-bound conditions reported
VIX rows labelled run-up toward the threshold

coudert_gex_2008.anchor: past peak (24-month max) incl. crisis months

gsy_2019.anchor: current level and later peaks (forward drawdown)

flags: pi(f) lower bound >= 0.5 for f = 1/4 and for f = 1/2; drawdown AUC lower bound > 0.6: a no-forecast score looks skilled on this label
in_progress_rule: drawdown from the trailing W-period high >= f * theta, for every row including this paper (W = H for the 1-minute BTC rows); VIX rows: rise from the trailing 20-day low >= f * distance to 25 (run-up toward the threshold, all on days with VIX < 25)
lower_bound: pi is a lower bound on the in-progress share of above-chance AUC only for a score with AUC > 0.5 and in-progress AUC >= not-yet AUC; the signed contribution pi*(AUC_in - 0.5)/(AUC - 0.5) is kept in the csv only (it exceeds 1 when the not-yet AUC is below 0.5)
quantities: pi(f) = share of positives whose event variable has covered at least f of the distance to its threshold; AUC overall, on not-yet positives and on in-progress positives, each against all negatives; the lower-bound conditions (AUC > 0.5 and in-progress AUC >= not-yet AUC) per score

scores.drawdown: current drawdown from the trailing W-period high (no forecast content)
scores.realized_vol: 20-day (daily), 12-month (monthly) or 24-hour (1-minute) standard deviation of log returns
scores.vix: for VIX labels: rise from the trailing 20-day low (run-up) and the VIX level (proximity)

title: Model-free diagnostic of reconstructed crash-label conventions (descriptive, v2)
